assertions.title: Local managed code interpreter remains the default code-execution path for OpenAI, Azure, and Google in this fork

steps.action: Run direct bridge API probes on dev rail (/v1/health, /v1/upload, /v1/exec twice with same session_id, /v1/files/{session_id}, /v1/download/{session_id}/{file_id})
steps.expected: Bridge endpoints are healthy and session-based code execution/file lifecycle works with warm-session reuse evidence
steps.observed: All probed endpoints returned 200; upload/exec/list/download succeeded; same-session exec timing improved (exec1 4.573s, exec2 2.545s).

steps.action: Verify dev API routing env for OpenAI/Azure/Google code interpreter
steps.expected: Routing defaults set to librechat-managed path

steps.action: Attempt user-surface model-chat validation across OpenAI/Azure/Google
steps.expected: Model-chat code turns validated through local bridge for all required providers
steps.observed: Blocked: validation user was repeatedly temp-banned during UI login attempts; Azure path unavailable (no allowed models for user), and Google/Azure executable credential paths were not available in this isolation run.

assertions.issues: Full OpenAI/Azure/Google model-chat user-surface coverage could not be completed due recurring temporary-ban and missing Azure/Google executable prerequisites for this persona.

assertions.title: Transcription started from /c/new cleans up draft state and stays appendable

steps.action: From /c/new upload audio and click Transcribe
steps.expected: Explicit Transcribe action navigates to dedicated transcript conversation
steps.observed: Transcribe action navigated to /c/5101e5b6-a11e-4d59-9df5-a35e1a0b3571 with transcript conversation created.

steps.expected: Draft file state/preview is cleared on source draft page
steps.observed: /c/new reopened with clean composer (no carried audio file chip).

steps.expected: Message input enabled for normal follow-up chat after transcription starts/completes
steps.observed: Message input stayed disabled; API showed transcription failed with "Missing data in response from the STT API" and follow-up chat was not appendable in UI.

assertions.issues: Appendable-follow-up requirement failed because transcript conversation composer stayed disabled after handoff.

assertions.title: Deleting an in-flight transcript does not break later transcription jobs

steps.action: Queue long transcription jobs from /c/new (40s and 600s audio) and capture immediate transcript conversations
steps.expected: Obtain in-flight processing window for deletion test
steps.observed: Jobs were created successfully but completed quickly in this environment before API delete attempts were executed.

steps.expected: Conversation can be removed while/after processing without crashing runner
steps.observed: DELETE /api/convos with body {arg:{conversationId}} returned 201 and conversation became 404 afterward.

steps.action: Queue follow-up transcription job after deletion
steps.observed: Blocked by anti-abuse temporary-ban: POST /api/files/transcribe returned 403 temporary-ban during follow-up attempt.

evidence.network: Pre-delete messages: VAL-FILES-009-predelete-messages-headers.txt/.json, VAL-FILES-009-600s-predelete-messages-headers.txt/.json; successful delete: VAL-FILES-009-delete2-headers.txt/.json + VAL-FILES-009-postdelete2-convo-headers.txt; follow-up blocked: VAL-FILES-009-followup-transcribe-headers.txt/body.json (403 temporary-ban).

assertions.issues: Could not conclusively execute the specific in-flight-delete-then-follow-up-run path because anti-abuse ban recurred during follow-up queueing.

assertions.title: Provider-native tool flows keep model gating, file metadata, and streaming UX coherent

steps.action: Fetch authenticated config/models for validation user
steps.expected: Confirm per-user model gating context for cross-provider checks
steps.observed: /api/models returned openAI + google + ollama only; azureOpenAI list was empty for this user.

steps.action: Collect native/local tool-path evidence from file/transcription/code-interpreter flows
steps.expected: Demonstrate coherent routing + metadata behavior across required providers
steps.observed: OpenAI-side file/transcription and local code-interpreter bridge evidence collected; full Azure/Gemini native-flow execution could not be exercised in this isolation run.

steps.expected: Complete user-surface verification with streaming/tool-status coherence
steps.observed: Blocked by recurring temporary-ban during login and missing executable Azure/Google credential paths.

evidence.network: /api/config 200 (VAL-CROSS-003-config-headers.txt/body.json); /api/models 200 (VAL-CROSS-003-models-headers.txt/body.json); code-interpreter routing env + endpoint probes in VAL-FILES-007-* artifacts.

assertions.issues: Cross-provider native-tool contract could not be completed because Azure path was unavailable for this user and recurring temporary-ban prevented stable UI flow continuation.

assertions.title: Background transcription remains a persistent conversation workflow, not a one-shot upload side effect

steps.action: From /c/new upload audio and click Transcribe explicitly
steps.expected: Transcription starts only on explicit action and immediately creates persistent conversation
steps.observed: Observed explicit Transcribe action and navigation into dedicated transcript conversations (/c/5101e5b6-..., /c/fd2344da-..., /c/b895726b-...).

steps.action: Verify background metadata progression and chat continuity
steps.expected: Background transcription metadata updates while preserving normal follow-up chat surface
steps.observed: Metadata transitions were observable via /api/messages (completed and failed states), but transcript UI follow-up composer remained disabled for the VAL-FILES-008 conversation.

evidence.network: /api/messages/5101e5b6-... 200 with failed status + error text (VAL-FILES-008-messages-after-reset.json); /api/messages/fd2344da-... and /api/messages/b895726b-... 200 with completed transcription metadata (VAL-FILES-009-predelete-messages.json, VAL-FILES-009-600s-predelete-messages.json).

assertions.issues: Cross-flow requirement failed on the final continuity condition because the transcript conversation was not appendable in UI after transcription handling.

frictions.description: Attach-menu upload entries are not direct HTML file inputs for automation.
frictions.resolution: Temporarily exposed hidden input[type=file] via in-page eval and used agent-browser upload on the exposed control.

frictions.description: Temporary-ban anti-abuse controls re-triggered multiple times during this run, including after successful partial checks.
frictions.resolution: Repeatedly applied required reset sequence; ban still recurred during late-stage follow-up checks.

frictions.description: Initial delete attempt used wrong endpoint shape (DELETE /api/convos/:id).
frictions.resolution: Used documented route DELETE /api/convos with JSON body {"arg":{"conversationId":"..."}}.

blockers.description: Recurring anti-abuse temporary-ban responses interrupted authenticated UI/API continuity for the assigned validation persona.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Ran dev persona reseed + docker restart librechat-dev-api + 25s wait multiple times; bans still recurred during follow-up operations.

blockers.description: Azure/Gemini cross-provider native-flow execution prerequisites were unavailable for this persona/environment partition.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Collected /api/models and routing env evidence; azureOpenAI model list remained empty and full cross-provider execution could not be completed.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions: 2 failed (VAL-FILES-008, VAL-CROSS-004) and 3 blocked (VAL-FILES-007, VAL-FILES-009, VAL-CROSS-003). Explicit /c/new transcription handoff and draft cleanup were confirmed, but transcript appendability failed, and recurring temporary-ban plus missing Azure/Gemini executable prerequisites blocked full cross-provider/in-flight follow-up coverage.
